notes.title: Demo vol.3 Update notes 2025-07-02
notes.notes:
[olist]
Encounter enemies earlier.

Enemies embedded in mold will now awaken when the mold is cleared.

Added new bullet animations for the Pea Shooter.

Introduced enhanced variants of flies.

Adjusted the protagonist's collision volume to prevent the camera from clipping into walls.


[/olist]
Hope you guys enjoy the update~

notes.title: Demo Vol.1 Update notes 2025-02-25
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for playing our demo! In response to recurring feedback, we've implemented a quick update to the demo version with the following changes:



 Added background sound for character dialogues


 Modified slug model's color and adjusted silk damage


 Reduced the threat of boom enemies


 Optimized level design flow, added silk sac anchor points' traversal routes, and improved enemy quantity/distribution


 Added screen mode options in settings menu


 Enhanced grappling hook control responsiveness



Happy gaming!
